private_irq_domain: Per-instance chip and managed mapping/domain cleanup; explicit exit removes managed action before immediate cleanup. Caller must quiesce parent dispatch and release all nested IRQ handlers first.
pinctrl_lifetime: Global provider mutex serializes operations, lookup publication, and removal; each platform lookup reference is balanced before return.
supply_lifetime: Regulator initialization owns a devres group and releases it on failure; success commits ordinary native managed resources. cdc_wcd_supply success owns the native device reference, caller releases it after use and synchronizes component lifetime.
